newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yangzhou Shipbuilding plans 150 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Yangzhou Shipbuilding plans 150 mln B share IPO.

text.p: China's Yangzhou Jingyang Shipbuilding Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 150 million B shares by October 1997 for listing in Shenzhen, a company official said on Tuesday.

Yangzhou will use proceeds from the foreign currency offer, which needs final approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, to boost ship production, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company's 1997 net profits are expected to reach between 85-90 million yuan ($10.2-10.8 million), he said but declined to say what accounting standards this was based on.
That figure compared with an unaudited 60 million yuan net profit in 1996 and 40 million yuan in 1995, he said.
Yangzhou had appointed Jiangsu Securities Co as the lead domestic underwriter but had not yet decided on an international consultant.
The company, based in Yangzhou city in the eastern province of Jiangsu, has 200 million outstanding institutional shares.
The firm, a maker of container and passenger ships, is among the latest batch of 33 companies selected by Beijing to list B shares.
